title: Walker letter: worked on defense policy with Vannevar Bush in 1947

tellings.quote: that set him up. He worked on defense policy. He a letter he says, "I worked on defense policy with in 1947 with Vanavar Bush."

plain: In 1947 the engineer Eric A. Walker is said to have worked on defense policy alongside Vannevar Bush, the senior science adviser to the government, and a letter of Walker's is cited for it. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this from the letter, quoting Walker as writing, 'I worked on defense policy with in 1947 with Vannevar Bush'; the words place Walker beside Bush that year, and whether that work touched the UFO matters Cameron links it to, the quoted line does not say. For Cameron it matters because it would put Walker inside the circle he believes handled the government's UFO secrets from 1947 on.
